04

Ascend NFT mechanics

NFT reward
weighting.

Ascend’s proposed model places the NFT benefit inside the direct HYPE reward pool. An eligible NFT increases the weight applied to its holder’s eligible HYPE stake for that distribution. The pool size varies with protocol revenue and HYPE purchase prices; the NFT does not add funds to it. Exact boosts and eligibility thresholds remain undisclosed.

Verify in the Ascend NFT docs ↗

Every rule,
traceable.

This tool models the published proposal. It is not affiliated with Ascend, Kinetiq or Elysium, and it is not a forecast, audit, investment recommendation or statement of final protocol behavior. It does not connect to Ascend’s gated application or prove participation in an Ascend test.

CURRENT BOUNDARY · CHECKED 10 OCT 2026

Elysium’s public testnet RPC, explorer, faucet and bridge are accessible. Ascend’s application currently shows private access. This site reads Elysium only and sends no transactions.
